cards.example_en: Nightly reading for twenty minutes became her resolution.
cards.example_zh: 每晚阅读二十分钟，成了她的决心。

cards.example_en: They resolve to finish the model before the science fair.
cards.example_zh: 他们决定在科学展之前完成这个模型。

cards.example_en: Water is a precious natural resource.
cards.example_zh: 在博茨瓦纳，水是宝贵的自然资源。

cards.example_en: They returned to their respective rooms.
cards.example_zh: 他们回到了各自的房间。

cards.example_en: Please respond to the email today.
cards.example_zh: 请今天回复这封邮件。

cards.example_en: Laughter was his response when the kitchen lights went out.
cards.example_zh: 厨房的灯灭了，他的反应是大笑。

cards.example_en: Feeding the class fish is my responsibility this week.
cards.example_zh: 这周给班里的鱼喂食是我的责任。

cards.example_en: Rest can restore your energy after a long match.
cards.example_zh: 长时间比赛之后，休息能恢复你的体力。

cards.example_en: The rules restrict phone use in class.
cards.example_zh: 规定限制课上使用手机。

cards.example_en: Grandpa will retire from the post office next year.
cards.example_zh: 爷爷明年将从邮局退休。

cards.example_en: The last chapter will reveal the answer.
cards.example_zh: 最后一章会揭示答案。

cards.example_en: I revise my history notes on the bus home.
cards.example_zh: 我在回家的公交车上复习历史笔记。

cards.example_en: Helping at the fair earned him a reward of free tickets.
cards.example_zh: 他在集市上帮忙，得到的报酬是几张免费票。

cards.example_en: These two lines rhyme.
cards.example_zh: 这两行押韵。

cards.example_en: Can you solve this riddle?
cards.example_zh: 你能解开这个谜语吗？

cards.example_en: The rule is rigid and allows no exception.
cards.example_zh: 这条规则很严格，没有例外。

cards.example_en: The peach is ripe and sweet.
cards.example_zh: 这只桃子熟了，很甜。

cards.example_en: We roast chicken for the family dinner.
cards.example_zh: 家庭晚餐我们烤鸡。

cards.example_en: The ball may roll under the sofa during the game.
cards.example_zh: 游戏进行时，球可能会滚到沙发底下。

cards.example_en: They took a romantic walk by the river.
cards.example_zh: 他们在河边浪漫地散了步。

cards.example_en: A bird sat on the roof.
cards.example_zh: 一只鸟停在屋顶上。

cards.example_en: A thick root has cracked the path beside the old tree.
cards.example_zh: 一条粗根把老树旁边的小路撑裂了。

cards.example_en: This route avoids the busy junction near the market.
cards.example_zh: 这条路线避开了市场附近拥挤的路口。

cards.example_en: Morning reading is part of my routine.
cards.example_zh: 晨读是我日常的一部分。

cards.example_en: The royal garden is open today.
cards.example_zh: 皇家花园今天开放。

cards.example_en: I used a rubber to erase the wrong maths sum.
cards.example_zh: 我用橡皮把算错的那道数学题擦掉了。

cards.example_en: It is rude to talk with your mouth full of food.
cards.example_zh: 嘴里塞满食物时说话是无礼的。

cards.example_en: They practise rugby on the muddy field behind school.
cards.example_zh: 他们在学校后面泥泞的场地上练习橄榄球。

cards.example_en: The rain did not ruin the picnic.
cards.example_zh: 雨没有毁了野餐。

cards.example_en: My grandparents live a quiet rural life among the fields.
cards.example_zh: 我的爷爷奶奶在田野间过着宁静的乡村生活。

cards.example_en: They sail across the bay in summer.
cards.example_zh: 夏天他们乘船穿过海湾。

cards.example_en: Her monthly salary covers the rent and the groceries.
cards.example_zh: 她每月的薪水够付租金和买菜的钱。

cards.example_en: The salesman explained the price.
cards.example_zh: 男推销员说明了价格。

cards.example_en: The saleswoman was patient and clear.
cards.example_zh: 女推销员耐心又清楚。

cards.example_en: The soup is too salty.
cards.example_zh: 这汤太咸了。

cards.example_en: The teacher showed a sample answer.
cards.example_zh: 老师展示了一份样本答案。

cards.example_en: A satellite sent back pictures of Earth.
cards.example_zh: 一颗卫星传回了地球的照片。

cards.example_en: Solving that hard puzzle gave him real satisfaction.
cards.example_zh: 解开那道难题，让他感到真正的满意。

cards.example_en: The cup sits on a saucer.
cards.example_zh: 杯子放在茶托上。

cards.example_en: Dad fried a sausage with eggs before leaving for work.
cards.example_zh: 爸爸上班前用鸡蛋配着煎了一根香肠。

cards.example_en: She put her saving in the bank.
cards.example_zh: 她把积蓄存进了银行。

cards.example_en: There is a saying about practice.
cards.example_zh: 有一句关于练习的谚语。

cards.example_en: The opening scene shows a rainy street at night.
cards.example_zh: 开场的场景是夜晚一条下雨的街道。

cards.example_en: The exam schedule is pinned beside the classroom door.
cards.example_zh: 考试日程钉在教室门旁边。

cards.example_en: She won a scholarship to university.
cards.example_zh: 她获得了大学奖学金。

cards.example_en: The scientific method starts with a clear question.
cards.example_zh: 科学方法从提出一个清楚的问题开始。

cards.example_en: The injured player began to scream on the football pitch.
cards.example_zh: 那名受伤的球员在足球场上开始惨叫。

cards.example_en: A stone sculpture stands in the square.
cards.example_zh: 广场上立着一座石雕。

cards.example_en: Secondary students often stay at school for club activities.
cards.example_zh: 中学生常常留在学校参加社团活动。

cards.example_en: The school secretary printed the letters after lunch.
cards.example_zh: 学校秘书午饭后把那些信打印了出来。

word.example_en: It is wrong to be rude to classmates.
